limitations: Invited private call with exactly three selected devices/accounts; no persistent community voice channels, SFU, larger rosters or device changes
Rejoin discovery is in memory in the same client session; no recovery after restart, epoch change, access loss or all peers expiring
Peer links/workers rebuild on participation changes and may briefly interrupt audio
General MLS membership changes still end local capture; group camera/share remains open
Synthetic audio in one runtime with real accounts/MLS; physical permissions, speakers/microphones and independent networks remain unvalidated
Loopback TURN only; TCP means client-to-relay TCP, not TURN-TLS or an all-TCP media route
macOS/Linux, external SFrame interoperability and independent security review remain open; no JavaScript/WebCrypto secure-erasure claim
